name: Libycosuchus
sum: Libycosuchus is a terrestrial notosuchian crocodyliform from the Late Cretaceous Bahariya Formation of Egypt.
wsnote: No body-length estimate is given in the sources consulted.
holotype: Not stated in the sources consulted for this draft; named by Stromer in 1914.
material: Remains from the Bahariya Formation of Egypt, including new material described in a later study.
biology: Terrestrial; it lived alongside the crocodilian Stomatosuchus and dinosaurs such as Spinosaurus.
author: Stromer 1914
